# Overview
```{r report-overview-setup, include=FALSE}
readMutationLog <- function(file, config){
          read_csv(file, col_types=cols(.default="d"), col_names=c('thisLength','parentLength','distance','saved','parent','savedIndex','savedFile','commonProbes','currentProbes','parentProbes','totalProbes')) %>%
          add_column(filename = file, config=config) %>%
          extract(filename, into = c("path","filename","target"), regex = "(.*)/(([^/]*)_mutation.log_.*)") %>%
          extract(filename, into = c("index"),".*_mutation.log_(\\d+)",remove=FALSE)

}
readExperimentMutationLogs <- function(dataDir) {
        benchmarks <- c('ant','maven','closure','rhino')
        # for each benchmark, read the mutation logs
        mutationLogs <- dat <- map(benchmarks, ~list.files(path=dataDir$path, recursive = F,
             pattern=paste0(.x,'_mutation.log_.*'), 
             full.names = TRUE)) %>% unlist()
        if(length(mutationLogs) == 0){
                return(data.frame(config=dataDir$name, thisLength=NA, parentLength=NA, distance=NA, saved=NA, parent=NA, savedIndex=NA, savedFile=NA, commonProbes=NA, currentProbes=NA, parentProbes=NA, totalProbes=NA, filename=NA, path=NA, target=NA, index=NA, isBaseline=NA))
        }
        return(mutationLogs %>%
        map_df(~readMutationLog(.,dataDir$name)) %>%
        mutate(isBaseline=dataDir$isBaseline)%>%
        complete(config, filename) %>%
        fill(names(.)))
}
configs <- fromJSON(params$dataDirs)
mutations <- map_dfr(configs, readExperimentMutationLogs)

readSingleJaCoCo <- function(filename){
  as.data.frame(fromJSON(file=filename)) %>% add_column(source=filename)
}
readJaCoCo <- function(dataDir){
  
  jacocoFiles <- Sys.glob(file.path(dataDir$path,"*_jacoco_summary.json"))
  
  # if jsonFiles is a vector, read them all in, else return default
  if(length(jacocoFiles) > 0){
    jacocoData <- map(jacocoFiles, readSingleJaCoCo) %>% map_dfr(~mutate(.x,config=dataDir$name,isBaseline=dataDir$isBaseline))
  } else {
    jacocoData <- data.frame(config=c(dataDir$name),branchesCovered=c(NA),branchesTotal=c(NA),source=c(NA), isBaseline=c(dataDir$isBaseline))
  }
  jacocoData
}
jacoco <- map_dfr(configs, readJaCoCo)%>% #mutate(idx = str_match(source, pattern="_(\\d+)_jacoco_summary.json")[,2])
extract(source, into = c("source","target","idx"), regex = "(.*/([^_]+)_([^_]+)_jacoco_summary.json)")

jacocoPValuesVsBaseline <- function(conf){
    jacoco %>%
    filter(config == conf | isBaseline) %>%
    filter(length(unique(unlist(config))) == 2) %>%
    mutate(config=as.factor(as.character(config)))%>%
    group_by(target) %>%
    do(p=wilcox.test(branchesCovered~config, data=., exact=FALSE)$p.value,
    vda=VD.A(formula=branchesCovered~config, data=.)$estimate)%>%
    summarise(p=p, vda=vda, target=target) %>%
    mutate(config=conf)
}
jacocoStats <- lapply(jacoco%>%filter(!isBaseline & !is.na(branchesCovered))%>%distinct(config)%>%pull(config), jacocoPValuesVsBaseline) %>% bind_rows() %>% as.data.frame()
if(nrow(jacocoStats) == 0){
    jacocoStats <- data.frame(config=NA, p=NA, vda=NA)
}
jacocoStats <- jacoco %>% group_by(config,target,isBaseline)%>%
    summarise(
        branchesTotal=mean(branchesTotal),
        branchesCovered=mean(branchesCovered),
    # sdBranchesCovered=sd(branchesCovered)
        ) %>%
        ungroup()%>%
        as.data.frame()%>%
         left_join(jacocoStats, by=c("config","target"))

# Input stats
readResultFile <- function(file, config) {
  read_csv(file, col_types=cols(.default="d")) %>%
          add_column(filename = file, config=config) %>%
          extract(filename, into = c("path","filename"), regex = "(.*)/([^/]*_plot_data.*)") %>%
          extract(filename, into = c("target","index"),"(.*)_plot_data_(\\d+)",remove=FALSE)%>%
          mutate(
                  campaignSecs = `# unix_time` - min(`# unix_time`))
}


readExperimentResults <- function(dataDir) {
  dat <- list.files(path=dataDir$path, recursive = F,
             pattern='*_plot_data_*',
             full.names = TRUE) %>%
        map_df(~readResultFile(.,dataDir$name)) %>%
        mutate(campaignMins = floor(campaignSecs / 60)) %>%
        complete(config, filename, campaignMins) %>%
        fill(names(.)) %>%
        group_by(campaignMins, config,target, path, filename, index) %>%
        summarise(across(everything(), last))  %>%
        mutate(total_inputs=invalid_inputs+valid_inputs, isBaseline=dataDir$isBaseline)
   if(!("b1" %in% colnames(dat))){
           dat <- dat %>% mutate(b0 = NA, b1 = NA, b2 = NA)
   }
   if("all_covered_probes" %in% colnames(dat)){
           dat %>% mutate(cov = all_covered_probes)
   }
   else if("all_cov" %in% colnames(dat)){
           dat %>% mutate(cov=all_cov)
   }
   else {
           dat %>% mutate(cov = NA)
   }
}

plotData <- map_dfr(configs, readExperimentResults)
```

## Branch coverage
```{r branch-coverage, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
baselineCoverage <- jacocoStats %>%filter(isBaseline)%>%select(target,branchesCovered)

jacocoTable <- jacocoStats %>% select(-c('isBaseline','branchesTotal'))%>%
    mutate(p=round(p,3), vda=round(vda,3), branches=round(branchesCovered, 0))%>%
    select(-branchesCovered)%>%
    inner_join(baselineCoverage, by='target')%>%
    mutate(branches = case_when(
        is.na(p)~format(branches, big.mark = ","),
    branches > branchesCovered & p <= 0.01 ~ sprintf("<span style='color: green; font-weight:bold;'>%s</span>", format(branches, big.mark = ",")),
branches > branchesCovered ~ sprintf("<span style=''>%s</span>", format(branches, big.mark = ",")),
branches < branchesCovered & p <= 0.01 ~ sprintf("<span style='color: red; font-weight: bold'>%s</span>", format(branches, big.mark = ",")),
branches < branchesCovered ~ sprintf("<span style=''>%s</span>", format(branches, big.mark = ",")),
TRUE~paste0(branches)
    )) %>% select(-branchesCovered)%>%
     pivot_wider(names_from = config, values_from = c(branches,p,vda), names_vary='slowest') 


# add a header row that extracts the config from the metric
configHeaders <- lapply(names(jacocoTable), function(name) {
    if (!str_count(name, "_")) " " else str_match(name, "[^_]+_([^_]+)$")[, 2]
})
valHeaders <- lapply(names(jacocoTable), function(name) {
    if (!str_count(name, "_")) name else str_match(name, "([^_]+)_[^_]+$")[, 2]
})
configCounts <- table(unlist(configHeaders))
colnames(jacocoTable) <- unlist(valHeaders)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
kable(jacocoTable, format="html", escape=FALSE, booktabs=TRUE, format.args = list(big.mark = ",",
                                                                        scientific = FALSE)) %>%
                                                                        add_header_above(unlist(configCounts)) 
```

## Total inputs
```{r total-inputs, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
inputCounts <- plotData %>% group_by(config,target,index,isBaseline) %>% summarise(total_inputs=max(total_inputs), validPercent=max(valid_inputs)/max(total_inputs)) %>%
pivot_longer(total_inputs:validPercent, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")

baselineInputCounts <- inputCounts %>%
    filter(isBaseline) %>% select(-isBaseline) %>% 
    group_by(target, metric) %>% summarise(mean_baseline=mean(value)) %>% ungroup()

inputCountspValuesVsBaseline <- function(conf){
    inputCounts %>%
    filter(config == conf | isBaseline) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value))%>%
    group_by(metric, target) %>%
    mutate(len = length(unique(unlist(config)))) %>%
    filter(length(unique(unlist(config))) == 2) %>%
    do(p=wilcox.test(value~config, data=., exact=FALSE)$p.value,
    vda=VD.A(formula=value~config, data=.)$estimate)%>%
    summarise(p=p, vda=vda,metric=metric,target=target) %>%
    mutate(config=conf)
}
inputCountPValues <- lapply(inputCounts%>%
                            filter(!isBaseline & !is.na(value))%>%
                            group_by(config)%>%
                            select(config) %>%
                            distinct(config) %>%
                            pull(config),
                            inputCountspValuesVsBaseline) %>% bind_rows() %>% as.data.frame()
inputCountMeans <- inputCounts %>% group_by(config,target, metric) %>% summarise(mean=mean(value))
inputsTable <- inputCountMeans %>%
    left_join(inputCountPValues, by=c('metric','target','config')) %>%
    inner_join(baselineInputCounts, by=c('target','metric')) %>%
        mutate(
            mean=case_when(metric == 'validPercent'~round(mean,2),
            TRUE~round(mean,0)),
            mean = case_when(
        is.na(p)~format(mean, big.mark = ","),
    mean > mean_baseline & p <= 0.01 ~ sprintf("<span style='color: green; font-weight:bold;'>%s</span>", format(mean, big.mark = ",")),
mean < mean_baseline & p <= 0.01 ~ sprintf("<span style='color: red; font-weight: bold'>%s</span>", format(mean, big.mark = ",")),
TRUE~format(mean, big.mark = ",") 
    )) %>% select(-mean_baseline)%>%
     pivot_wider(names_from = config, values_from = c(mean,p,vda), names_vary='slowest') %>%
     arrange(metric,target)
# inputsTable
# add a header row that extracts the config from the metric
configHeaders <- lapply(names(inputsTable), function(name) {
    if (!str_count(name, "_")) " " else str_match(name, "[^_]+_([^_]+)$")[, 2]
})
valHeaders <- lapply(names(inputsTable), function(name) {
    if (!str_count(name, "_")) name else str_match(name, "([^_]+)_[^_]+$")[, 2]
})
configCounts <- table(unlist(configHeaders))
colnames(inputsTable) <- unlist(valHeaders)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

kable(inputsTable, format="html", booktabs=TRUE, digits=2, format.args = list(big.mark = ",",
                                                                        scientific = FALSE)) %>%
                                                                        add_header_above(unlist(configCounts)) 
``` 

## Similarity statistics
```{r similarity-stats, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
inputSimilarity <- mutations %>% mutate(probeSimilarity=commonProbes/totalProbes,
isSameInput = distance==0,
textSimilarity = distance/max(thisLength,parentLength)
) %>%
    group_by(config,target,filename,isBaseline) %>%
    summarise(probeSimilarity=mean(probeSimilarity),
    equalInputRatio=sum(isSameInput)/n(),
    textSimilarity=mean(textSimilarity) 
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_longer(c("probeSimilarity","equalInputRatio","textSimilarity"), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") 
    # pivot_wider(names_from = config, values_from = probeSimilarity)

baselineSimilarity <- inputSimilarity %>% filter(isBaseline) %>% select(target,metric,value) %>% group_by(target,metric) %>% summarise(mean_baseline=mean(value)) %>% ungroup()

inputSimilaritypValuesVsBaseline <- function(conf){
    inputSimilarity %>%
    filter(config == conf | isBaseline) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value))%>%
    group_by(metric, target) %>%
    mutate(len = length(unique(unlist(config)))) %>%
    filter(length(unique(unlist(config))) == 2) %>%
    do(p=wilcox.test(value~config, data=., exact=FALSE)$p.value,
    vda=VD.A(formula=value~config, data=.)$estimate)%>%
    summarise(p=p, vda=vda,metric=metric,target=target) %>%
    mutate(config=conf)
}

similarityStats <- lapply(inputSimilarity%>%
                            filter(!isBaseline & !is.na(value))%>%
                            distinct(config) %>%
                            pull(config),
                            inputSimilaritypValuesVsBaseline) %>% bind_rows() %>% as.data.frame()
similarityMeans <- inputSimilarity %>% group_by(config,target, metric) %>% summarise(mean=mean(value)) 

# if similarityStats is empty, create a dummy row
if(nrow(similarityStats) == 0){
    similarityStats <- data.frame(config=NA, p=NA, vda=NA, metric=NA,target=NA,config=NA)
}


similarityTable <- similarityMeans %>%
    left_join(similarityStats, by=c('metric','target','config')) %>%
    inner_join(baselineSimilarity, by=c('target','metric'))%>%
    mutate(
        mean=case_when(
            mean < mean_baseline & p <= 0.01 ~ sprintf("<span style='color: red; font-weight: bold'>%.2f</span>", mean),
            mean > mean_baseline & p <= 0.01 ~ sprintf("<span style='color: green; font-weight:bold;'>%.2f</span>", mean),
            TRUE~sprintf("%.2f", mean)
        )
    ) %>%select(-mean_baseline)%>%
     pivot_wider(names_from = config, values_from = c(mean,p,vda), names_vary='slowest') %>%
     arrange(metric,target)

# add a header row that extracts the config from the metric
configHeaders <- lapply(names(similarityTable), function(name) {
    if (!str_count(name, "_")) " " else str_match(name, "[^_]+_([^_]+)$")[, 2]
})
valHeaders <- lapply(names(similarityTable), function(name) {
    if (!str_count(name, "_")) name else str_match(name, "([^_]+)_[^_]+$")[, 2]
})
configCounts <- table(unlist(configHeaders))
colnames(similarityTable) <- unlist(valHeaders)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")


kable(similarityTable, format="html", booktabs=TRUE, digits=2, format.args = list(big.mark = ",",
                                                                        scientific = FALSE)) %>%
                                                                        add_header_above(unlist(configCounts))
```
